title: cyclosorus affinis
intro: Cyclosorus affinis, commonly known as the Asian Rattlesnake Fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Blechnaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus affinis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
